remarks:
Welcome to this ideally situated home in Buffalo's vibrant Elmwood neighborhood! This inviting two-bedroom townhouse offers a comfortable layout, a private patio, and an unbeatable location just steps from the shops, restaurants, and attractions along the Elmwood strip.
Inside, the spacious kitchen features ceramic tile flooring and a convenient breakfast bar, flowing into the family room with hardwood flooring and sliding glass doors that open to the private patio. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bathroom. The finished basement adds valuable living space, complete with a second living room and a built-in bar, ideal for entertaining or relaxing. All appliances are included, along with the washer and dryer for added convenience.
Enjoy your own private outdoor patio, perfect for unwinding or gathering with guests. The townhouse layout offers distinct living and entertaining areas across multiple levels.
Conveniently located within approximately 10 minutes of Buffalo's hospitals and college campuses, with easy access to the I-190 for commuting and travel throughout the area. Enjoy the energy of Elmwood living with local shopping, dining, and activities right outside your door!
